documentation.content: Purchase verification returned HTTP 5xx or logged validation_status unavailable/error. Slow requests have a separate latency policy. Inspect validation_status and Play timeout warnings; an auto-closed incident does not prove a later successful purchase.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="sms-ensemble" AND ((httpRequest.requestUrl:"/api/purchases/verify" AND httpRequest.status>=500) OR (jsonPayload.message="purchase_verification" AND (jsonPayload.validation_status="unavailable" OR jsonPayload.validation_status="error")))
